title: These sheets aren't very soft.
text:
These sheets aren't very soft.. The color is nice, but the sheets aren't very soft. They aren't thin like other sheets, but not soft.

They wrinkle bad even when removing right after they are dried in the dryer. They will need to be ironed to look nice.

They are a good quality and I think they will last a good whie.

product_metadata.title: Madison Park Peached 100% Percale Cotton Breathable Absorbent Ultra Soft Luxury Premium Hotel Sheet Set Bedding, King Size, Aqua 4 Piece
